# The Estate Organizer (American Edition)

> The Estate Organizer is a fill-in-the-blanks workbook for American families. You write down where everything is kept: bank accounts, retirement accounts, insurance policies, where the passwords live, funeral wishes, final instructions. Then the person who has to sort it all out one day is not left guessing. It is not an app and it is not a cloud service. The printed edition is a coil bound book you fill in by hand. The digital edition is a fillable file that stays on your own computer. What you write is never stored on our servers. The Organizer is a record-keeping tool. It is not legal, financial or tax advice, and it does not replace a Will or the work an attorney does. It sits alongside those documents. Operated by Prestige Worldwright Pty Ltd (ABN 46 691 517 692). Australian and Canadian editions are published separately.

## Start here

- [The Estate Organizer](https://theestateorganiser.com/): what the book is, what sits inside it, and why a Will on its own leaves gaps.
- [Pick where you're starting](https://theestateorganiser.com/start-here/): one page that points you to the right product depending on whether you are organizing your own affairs or handling someone else's.
- [The 2-Minute Estate Readiness Check](https://theestateorganiser.com/estate-quiz/): a free two-minute quiz on how ready your family would be if something happened tomorrow.

## Free

- [The Free Executor Toolkit](https://theestateorganiser.com/toolkit/): a free PDF guide for whoever handles an estate, covering the first 48 hours, the first-year timeline, common missteps, plus an expense log and notification templates.

## Companion products

- [The Estate Conversation Kit](https://theestateorganiser.com/the-estate-conversation-kit/): $27 USD. Word-for-word opening lines for the seven family conversations that usually come before the paperwork makes sense.
- [The Executor's Companion](https://theestateorganiser.com/executors-companion/): $39 USD. A fillable working file for someone administering an estate right now, so every call, payment and letter is logged in one place.
